messages.subject: Mark-recapture models in INLA
parts:
Hello all,

I'm fitting Cormack-Jolly-Seber models to capture histories of a wild bird species to estimate survival. Due to the size of the dataset (~100000 individuals), fitting anything but the simplest models using MCMC (in WinBUGS) takes more time than I have. I'm interested as to whether I could save time by implementing my models in INLA rather than BUGS. So...

a) Is it possible to fit CJS models (or other mark-recapture models) in INLA?

b) Is anyone doing so?

Many thanks!
Jacob Davies
